exact.4 個特徵排成柱 → 維度 d=4，就是 $\\mathbb{R}^4$ 的定義: 4 features stacked into a column → dimension d=4, which is exactly the definition of $\mathbb{R}^4$.
exact.本講採 $d\\times n$（欄為樣本）；轉置 $n\\times d$ 也: This lecture uses $d\times n$ (columns are samples); the transpose $n\times d$ is also common. A single cat image is a $100\times100=10{,}000$-dimensional vector.
exact.$7+6.5=13.5$；幾何上二維點沿法向量 $\\mathbf{w}=[1,: $7+6.5=13.5$; geometrically, the 2D point is orthogonally projected along the normal vector $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$ onto a 1D number line, with warm colors at the high end.

47f59e030f18.zh: ML THEORY II · 幾何線性代數表徵
47f59e030f18.en: ML THEORY II · Geometric Linear-Algebra Representations

5521805d092e.zh:
把世界變成向量
Turn the World into Vectors

13cfe02790c7.zh: 從特徵向量到資料矩陣，再到帶參數的空間映射
13cfe02790c7.en: From feature vectors to the data matrix, and on to parameterized mappings between spaces

02f0763f8dbe.zh: Scroll Mode · 自學預習版 (Scroll · self-study) ｜ 中英雙語 Bilingual
02f0763f8dbe.en: Scroll Mode · Self-study preview edition | Chinese–English bilingual

b9f72df1e574.zh:
電腦是個高度近視的大笨蛋，
它要怎麼看懂世界？ Computer is near-sighted — how does it see the world? Answer: turn everything into numbers — a vector.
b9f72df1e574.en:
The computer is a hopelessly near-sighted big dummy —
so how is it supposed to understand the world? Answer: turn everything into numbers — a vector.

8af6bf31a82e.zh: 暴力解法：把人、貓、股票統統拆成一串數字，排成一根柱子。Violent trick: stack numbers into a column vector.
8af6bf31a82e.en: The brute-force approach: break people, cats, and stocks all down into a string of numbers and stack them into a column.

052f35285bad.zh: 什麼叫「把世界變成向量」？What is Vectorization?
052f35285bad.en: What does it mean to “turn the world into vectors”?

37da822f9e34.zh: Fig 1 · 4 維健康向量 vs 10,000 維貓咪向量 (4D health vs 10,000D image)
37da822f9e34.en: Fig 1 · A 4-dimensional health vector vs a 10,000-dimensional cat vector

9aa1f7b8363f.zh: 醫生不會在病歷卡上畫你的自畫像，他量血壓、血糖、身高、體重。Doctor measures, not portraits — features.
9aa1f7b8363f.en: A doctor doesn't draw your portrait on your medical chart; they measure your blood pressure, blood sugar, height, and weight.

77600ad95b47.zh: 特徵 (Feature)：可量化的觀測屬性；把 $d$ 個特徵排成一根柱子，就叫特徵向量 (Feature Vector) $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^d$。Stack $d$ features into a column vector.
77600ad95b47.en: Feature: a quantifiable, observable attribute. Stack $d$ features into a column and you get a feature vector $\mathbf{x}\in\mathbb{R}^d$.

d002da0a4dc2.zh: 黑白貓照 $100\times100$ → 10,000 灰階值排成長條 → $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$ 超長向量。Flatten $100\times100$ grayscale → $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$.
d002da0a4dc2.en: A $100\times100$ black-and-white cat photo → 10,000 grayscale values laid out in one long strip → a super-long vector in $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$.

11043c1ad5b0.zh: 「人」無法被計算，「$[120,95,175,70]$」可以。向量化是讓近視的電腦能摸到世界的拐杖。Numbers are the cane for a near-sighted computer.
11043c1ad5b0.en: A “person” can't be computed, but “$[120,95,175,70]$” can. Vectorization is the cane that lets a near-sighted computer feel its way around the world.

e4e060d9bc93.zh: 小明在電腦眼裡：$\mathbb{R}^4$ 裡的一個點Xiaoming as a Point in $\mathbb{R}^4$
e4e060d9bc93.en: To the computer, Xiao Ming is a point in $\mathbb{R}^4$

7a3316f179b7.zh: 符號白話 · Notation in Plain Words

312f85415034.zh: $\mathbb{R}$ = 實數（帶小數的數）；上標 $4$ = 維度 $d=4$；$\in$ = 「屬於」。$\mathbb{R}$ reals, $4$ dims, $\in$ belongs to.
312f85415034.en: $\mathbb{R}$ = the real numbers (numbers that can have decimals); superscript $4$ = the dimension $d=4$; $\in$ = “belongs to”.

6a610f6efb1b.zh: 四個數依序：收縮壓 120、血糖 95、身高 175、體重 70。電腦把小明當成「活在四維空間的幾何點」。Four numbers → point in 4D space.
6a610f6efb1b.en: The four numbers, in order: systolic blood pressure 120, blood sugar 95, height 175, weight 70. The computer treats Xiao Ming as “a geometric point living in four-dimensional space”.

a58de46c1cc4.zh: 病歷卡上的一個人 a person on card
a58de46c1cc4.en: A person on a medical chart

8dcb1e6e9644.en: Has a face and a name

07159d6b3f58.zh: 無法直接做數學 not computable
07159d6b3f58.en: Can't do math on it directly

c272ce649eab.zh: 幾何點、可算距離 point, distance-ready
c272ce649eab.en: A geometric point; distances can be computed

d682d5f4a2a9.zh: 可比較、投影、分類 comparable & projectable
d682d5f4a2a9.en: Can be compared, projected, and classified

1d606482143a.zh: 貓咪被「降維打擊」成 $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$Cat Flattened into $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$
1d606482143a.en: The Cat Gets a “Dimensional Strike”: Flattened into $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$

1106522ee59f.zh: $100 \times 100 = 10{,}000$ 像素，每格灰階 $0\sim255$，按列排成長條。10k pixels, row-major flatten.
1106522ee59f.en: $100 \times 100 = 10{,}000$ pixels, each holding a grayscale value from $0\sim255$, laid out row by row into one long strip.

005648cde2e1.zh: 像一根短筷子，手就能握住。Short chopstick.
005648cde2e1.en: Like a short chopstick: you can hold it in one hand.

745db94f55af.zh: 像一根從台北排到高雄的超長筷子，電腦照樣握得住。Taipei-to-Kaohsiung chopstick — still a vector.
745db94f55af.en: Like a super-long chopstick stretching all the way from Taipei to Kaohsiung, and the computer can still hold it just fine.

2a6f5fabf408.zh: 維度 $d$ 就是「你量了幾種東西」。量越多，筷子越長。Dimension $d$ = how many measurements.
2a6f5fabf408.en: The dimension $d$ is simply “how many kinds of things you measured.” The more you measure, the longer the chopstick.

4dfaf38186e2.zh: 資料矩陣 $X$：把大家抓來排排站Data Matrix $X$: Stack Everyone Side by Side
4dfaf38186e2.en: Data Matrix $X$: Line Everyone Up Side by Side

c29c7f53f005.zh: Fig 2 · $d$ 列特徵 × $n$ 欄樣本 — 每欄是一個 $\mathbf{x}_i$ ($d$ rows × $n$ cols)
c29c7f53f005.en: Fig 2 · $d$ feature rows × $n$ sample columns — each column is one $\mathbf{x}_i$

72a3af2ce51c.zh: 每位同學 $\mathbf{x}_i\in\mathbb{R}^d$ 當一欄，並排拼成大表格：
72a3af2ce51c.en: Each student $\mathbf{x}_i\in\mathbb{R}^d$ becomes one column, and the columns are placed side by side into one big table:

0852ec22d479.zh: 橫列 $d$ = 特徵種類，直欄 $n$ = 樣本數。Rows $d$ features, cols $n$ samples.
0852ec22d479.en: The $d$ rows = kinds of features; the $n$ columns = number of samples.

191eb2f7e458.zh: 像把全班病歷卡並排成 Excel：每一欄是一個人，每一列是一種檢查。Columns = people, rows = tests.
191eb2f7e458.en: It's like lining up the whole class's medical record cards side by side in Excel: each column is one person, each row is one kind of test.

ecffb75d64e1.zh: 特徵維度，量了幾種。How many features.
ecffb75d64e1.en: Feature dimension: how many kinds of things were measured.

2675c0cc6de7.zh: 樣本數，有幾個人。How many samples.
2675c0cc6de7.en: Number of samples: how many people there are.

052c5df96466.zh: 本講採 $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$（欄為樣本）；有些教材轉置成 $n\times d$（列為樣本），數學等價、排版不同，認得就好。Some texts use $n\times d$ transposed — same math.
052c5df96466.en: This lecture uses $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$ (columns are samples); some textbooks transpose it to $n\times d$ (rows are samples). The math is equivalent, only the layout differs; just learn to recognize both.

916ee2e04d5c.zh: 模型 $f_\theta$：從 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 到 $\mathbb{R}^p$ 的空間變換Model $f_\theta$: Mapping Between Spaces

eb24181340fd.zh: 投入 $d$ 維向量（原料），轉動旋鈕 $\theta$，吐出 $p$ 維結果（果汁）。Input $d$-vector → turn knob $\theta$ → output $p$-vector.
eb24181340fd.en: Feed in a $d$-dimensional vector (the ingredients), turn the knob $\theta$, and out comes a $p$-dimensional result (the juice).

31dc955a1d1a.zh: 輸入 $d=2$（讀書時數、缺課次數） → 輸出 $p=1$（分數）$d=2 \to p=1$ scalar.
31dc955a1d1a.en: Input $d=2$ (hours of study, number of absences) → output $p=1$ (the score). In short, $d=2 \to p=1$: a scalar.

7eb78045ba4a.zh: 輸入 $d=10$ 指標 → 輸出 $p=1$ 生病機率$d=10 \to p=1$ prob.
7eb78045ba4a.en: Input $d=10$ health indicators → output $p=1$, the probability of being ill. In short, $d=10 \to p=1$: a probability.

a520f8ffe5c3.zh: 榨汁機比喻：$\theta$ 就是旋鈕Juicer Analogy: $\theta$ is the Knob
a520f8ffe5c3.en: The Juicer Analogy: $\theta$ Is the Knob

839fce476ac3.zh: 機器學習的「學習」 = 在數據庫裡不斷調轉旋鈕，直到果汁符合期望。Learning = tuning knobs until juice tastes right.
839fce476ac3.en: The “learning” in machine learning = turning the knobs again and again on the data until the juice turns out the way you want.

7ba329bb20eb.zh: 投入 $d$ 維特徵向量Input vector.

64a7de54a7c8.zh: 齒輪、加權比重Weights & bias.

91f00e02e579.zh: 吐出 $p$ 維預測Output prediction.

3dbe7bb8d7a4.zh: $\theta$（Theta）= 模型的齒輪組；轉對了，果汁就甜。$\theta$ = gears; tuned well → sweet juice.
3dbe7bb8d7a4.en: $\theta$ (theta) = the model's set of gears; tune them right, and the juice comes out sweet.

c1935e02db1e.zh: 線性模型：權重 $\mathbf{w}$ 定方向、偏置 $b$ 定平移Linear Model: $\mathbf{w}$ Direction, $b$ Shift
c1935e02db1e.en: Linear Model: The Weights $\mathbf{w}$ Set the Direction, the Bias $b$ Sets the Shift

c4301265ffae.zh: $\mathbf{w}$ 在幾何中定義投影方向與伸縮；$b$ 是整體平移基準量。$\mathbf{w}$ projects & scales, $b$ shifts.
c4301265ffae.en: Geometrically, $\mathbf{w}$ defines the projection direction and the scaling; $b$ is the overall shift, the baseline offset.

e9df4be0446b.zh: 決定資料往哪壓扁 where to flatten
e9df4be0446b.en: Decides which way the data gets squashed flat

dc7be00521b6.zh: 數線原點平移 origin shift
dc7be00521b6.en: Shifts the origin of the number line

188dd2f01f45.zh: 決定基準高度 baseline level

71d98f3d943a.zh: 動手算：$w_1=1, w_2=1, b=0$ 的降維打擊Hand Calc: $f(\mathbf{x})=x_1+x_2$
71d98f3d943a.en: Hand calculation: the dimension-reduction strike of $w_1=1, w_2=1, b=0$, i.e. $f(\mathbf{x})=x_1+x_2$

7835fa104f3b.zh: 此時模型簡化為 $f_\theta(\mathbf{x}) = x_1 + x_2$，把平面上的點全部壓到一條數線上。Plane points collapsed onto a line.
7835fa104f3b.en: The model then simplifies to $f_\theta(\mathbf{x}) = x_1 + x_2$, squashing every point in the plane onto a single number line.

8612f6eae850.zh: 近原點 低端 藍
8612f6eae850.en: Near the origin, low end, blue

9f88ae3ffcaf.zh: 遠離原點 高端 暖色
9f88ae3ffcaf.en: Far from the origin, high end, warm color

6790cb199fdd.zh: 越靠近原點的點 → 數線低端（藍）；越遠離原點 → 高端（暖色）。這就是 $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]^\top$ 決定的投影。Near origin → low/blue; far → high/warm.
6790cb199fdd.en: Points closer to the origin → low end of the number line (blue); points farther from the origin → high end (warm colors). This is the projection determined by $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]^\top$.

af66a4b48c3b.zh: 精準幾何：$\mathbb{R}^2$ 壓扁到 $\mathbb{R}^1$Geometry: $\mathbb{R}^2$ Collapsed to $\mathbb{R}^1$

c3813b773b1e.zh: Fig 3 · 左：$\mathbb{R}^2$ 點雲 + $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$ 方向線 + 正交虛線投影；右：$\mathbb{R}^1$ 色階數線 (left: cloud & orthogonal projection; right: 1D color axis)
c3813b773b1e.en: Fig 3 · Left: point cloud in $\mathbb{R}^2$ + direction line of $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$ + dashed orthogonal projections; right: color-scale number line in $\mathbb{R}^1$

57f64c1e0579.en: How to read the left plot

7b97dd2f0ef5.zh: 每個圓點是 $\mathbf{x}_i$，方塊是它在 $\mathbf{w}$ 線上的正交投影，虛線是投影路徑。Dots = samples, squares = projections, dashed = path.
7b97dd2f0ef5.en: Each dot is an $\mathbf{x}_i$, each square is its orthogonal projection onto the $\mathbf{w}$ line, and the dashed lines are the projection paths.

e6f06eb3c47c.en: How to read the right plot

3788dd3b7d8b.zh: 同一批點按 $f_\theta(\mathbf{x})$ 落在色階數線，顏色即數值。Same points on 1D color axis.
3788dd3b7d8b.en: The same points placed on the color-scale number line according to $f_\theta(\mathbf{x})$; the color is the value.

a5fcc7b07d90.zh: 投影值分佈 · Projected Values — 7 個點從 3.5 到 16.0 (color = value)
a5fcc7b07d90.en: Distribution of projected values: 7 points from 3.5 to 16.0 (color = value)

324f1d486adf.zh: 資料流架構：世界 → 向量 → 矩陣 → 映射Architecture: World → Vector → Matrix → Mapping
324f1d486adf.en: Data-flow architecture: World → Vector → Matrix → Mapping

a40989b8e2ff.zh: 把今天三個主角串成一條流水線。Connect three protagonists into a pipeline.
a40989b8e2ff.en: Let's chain today's three main characters into one pipeline.

4116d1a4ccd6.zh: 機器學習資料表徵與模型流向
4116d1a4ccd6.en: ML data representation and model flow

f58731e54eb6.zh: 幾何實質：高維特徵空間 → 投影/伸縮/平移 → 低維輸出空間
f58731e54eb6.en: Geometric essence: high-dim feature space → project/scale/shift → low-dim output space

dba167961e1c.zh: Fig 4 · 流水線：世界 → 向量 → 矩陣 → 映射（SVG 幾何架構）(pipeline with geometric meaning)
dba167961e1c.en: Fig 4 · Pipeline: World → Vector → Matrix → Mapping (geometric architecture in SVG)

9b75a6ea5a48.zh: 今日精要總結Summary — Three Pillars

0dc1c96c3f8a.zh: 現實物件無法計算，先提 $d$ 特徵變 $\mathbb{R}^d$ 幾何點。Extract $d$ features → point in $\mathbb{R}^d$.
0dc1c96c3f8a.en: Real-world objects can't be computed on, so first extract $d$ features to turn them into geometric points in $\mathbb{R}^d$.

24917cc8f74b.zh: $n$ 樣本並排 $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$，列 $d$ 特徵、欄 $n$ 樣本。$X$ stacks $n$ vectors.
24917cc8f74b.en: Place the $n$ samples side by side to form $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$, so $X$ stacks the $n$ vectors: rows are the $d$ features, columns are the $n$ samples.

f1ef13d558d1.zh: $f_\theta: \mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^p$ 是空間變換；$\mathbf{w}$ 定方向尺度、$b$ 定平移。$\mathbf{w}$ directs, $b$ shifts.
f1ef13d558d1.en: $f_\theta: \mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^p$ is a transformation of space; $\mathbf{w}$ sets the direction and scale, $b$ sets the shift.

04aec4fd9127.zh: 電腦先把世界壓成向量，再把向量排成矩陣，最後用 $\theta$ 控制的投影把高維壓到你想要的答案上。World → vectors → matrix → $\theta$-controlled projection.
04aec4fd9127.en: The computer first squashes the world into vectors, then lines the vectors up into a matrix, and finally uses a projection controlled by $\theta$ to squash the high-dimensional space down onto the answer you want.

eb81d7a2f9ab.zh: 下一步路線圖Roadmap — Where to next?

6be4ae0c8f72.zh: 距離與相似度 (Distance & Similarity)

aa2c86d81813.zh: 有了向量就能算「誰跟誰像」：歐氏距離、內積、餘弦。Vectors → distance & similarity.
aa2c86d81813.en: Once you have vectors, you can compute “who resembles whom”: Euclidean distance, inner product, cosine.

4700dd85b066.zh: 損失地形再探 (Loss Landscape)

d3277eeeaacd.zh: 把 $f_\theta(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}+b$ 的損失畫成碗，梯度往哪滾？Bowl of loss — where does gradient roll?
d3277eeeaacd.en: Plot the loss of $f_\theta(\mathbf{x})=\mathbf{w}^\top\mathbf{x}+b$ as a bowl: which way does the gradient roll?

77bf7ae4c063.zh: 線不夠用時，加激活函數讓榨汁機不再只是投影。Add activation beyond linear projection.
77bf7ae4c063.en: When a line isn't enough, add an activation function so the juicer is no longer just a projection.

ad85347a72d2.zh: 思考題 · 提取練習Reflection — Test Your Understanding

47c0ed19cf8f.zh: Q1. 小明 $\mathbf{x}=[120,95,175,70]^\top$ 為何是 $\mathbb{R}^4$？Why $\mathbb{R}^4$?
47c0ed19cf8f.en: Q1. Why is Xiao Ming's $\mathbf{x}=[120,95,175,70]^\top$ in $\mathbb{R}^4$?

74cfe9bcffe1.zh: A. 因為小明有 4 個名字 (4 names)
74cfe9bcffe1.en: A. Because Xiao Ming has 4 names

438728045dbd.zh: B. 因為抽了 4 個特徵排成柱向量，$d=4$ (4 features → $d=4$)
438728045dbd.en: B. Because 4 features were extracted and stacked into a column vector, $d=4$

f404e491f8c9.zh: C. 因為小明 4 歲 (age 4)
f404e491f8c9.en: C. Because Xiao Ming is 4 years old

2653ad93e3f3.zh: D. 因為矩陣一定是 4×4 (must be 4×4)
2653ad93e3f3.en: D. Because the matrix must always be 4×4

e7ed5a90a92b.zh: Q2. 班上 $n$ 人每人 $d$ 特徵，$X$ 的形狀是？貓咪單張 10,000 維算什麼？Shape of $X$? Cat dims?
e7ed5a90a92b.en: Q2. A class has $n$ students, each with $d$ features. What is the shape of $X$? And what does a single 10,000-dimensional cat image count as?

0a35dd364242.zh: A. $X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$ 才是唯一正確 (only $n\times d$)
0a35dd364242.en: A. $X\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times d}$, i.e. $n\times d$, is the only correct answer

98b014330e53.zh: C. 本講 $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$（欄為樣本），貓是 $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$ 單向量 ($d\times n$ col-sample; cat $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$)
98b014330e53.en: C. In this lecture $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$, i.e. $d\times n$ (columns are samples), and the cat is a single vector in $\mathbb{R}^{10000}$

9d14c124c5f2.zh: Q3. $f_\theta(\mathbf{x})=1\cdot x_1+1\cdot x_2$，$\mathbf{x}=(7,6.5)$ 時輸出？幾何上發生什麼？Output? Geometry?
9d14c124c5f2.en: Q3. $f_\theta(\mathbf{x})=1\cdot x_1+1\cdot x_2$: what is the output when $\mathbf{x}=(7,6.5)$? What happens geometrically?

0add20eb5640.zh: A. $13.5$；二維點沿 $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$ 被壓扁到一維數線 (13.5; flatten onto line)
0add20eb5640.en: A. $13.5$; the 2D point is squashed along $\mathbf{w}=[1,1]$ onto a 1D number line

6431272be654.zh: C. $0$；因為 $b=0$ 所以歸零 (0 due to $b=0$)

676dbfc89835.zh:
向量是電腦的拐杖，
$\mathbf{w}$ 決定往哪壓扁。 Vectors are the cane; $\mathbf{w}$ chooses the flattening. $b$ shifts the baseline.
676dbfc89835.en:
Vectors are the computer's crutch;
$\mathbf{w}$ decides which way to squash. $b$ shifts the baseline.

8e77271bac41.en: World → $\mathbb{R}^d$ → $X\in\mathbb{R}^{d\times n}$ → $f_\theta: \mathbb{R}^d\to\mathbb{R}^p$Vectors → data matrix $X$ → mapping $f_\theta$.
